contract.goalSummary: You are creating the THREE.JS SIMULATION implementation contract for visualizing and testing MyActuator motors. Based on the product data: - Motor series: RMD-X (Planetary), RH (Harmonic), CEM (Cycloid), RMD-H (DD), RMD-L (DD), FL/
